name: Geo Generative Engine Optimisation
description: Monitor AI citations, score content for AI search visibility, validate crawl parity, and optimise structured data for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. The only plugin in the directory dedicated to Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) — the emerging discipline of making content visible to AI search engines. Includes 6 skills: geo-score, citation-check, crawl-parity, schema-optimization, ai-content-strategy, and llms-txt.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **1 agent**, **5 commands** and **6 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (5): `ai-content-strategy` (Plan and brief content specifically optimised for AI search citation), `citation-monitor` (Run the 30-check citation protocol across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews), `crawl-parity` (Compare Googlebot crawl coverage against AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) using server logs cross-referenced with GSC data), `geo-scoring` (Score any URL or content against the 5-layer GEO Stack), `schema-optimization` (Audit, fix, and generate JSON-LD structured data optimised for AI search engines)
- **Agents** (1): `weekly-geo-monitor` (Runs the full weekly GEO monitoring sequence autonomously: citation check across all tracked queries, crawl parity report, GEO…)
- **Commands** (5): `brief` (Generate a GEO-optimised content brief for a keyword), `citation-check` (Run the 30-check citation protocol for a domain or URL across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO), `crawl-parity` (Compare Googlebot vs AI crawler access patterns), `geo-score` (Score any URL or content against the 5-layer GEO Stack), `schema-check` (Audit JSON-LD structured data on any URL and output corrected, GEO-optimised schema ready to deploy)
- **MCP servers** (6): `~~search_console`, `~~analytics`, `~~serp_data`, `~~crawler`, `~~knowledge_base`, `~~documents`

Installs with `claude plugin install geo-generative-engine-optimisation@claude-community` from `arturseo-geo/cowork-geo-plugin`.
